messages:
oliver: Flagging ~90 invoices where 'experimental_fee' line is missing but Stripe shows the charge applied. NetSuite invoice total is lower than expected.

nora: Example invoice id inv_6Tuv... — Stripe recorded line item, NS shows nothing. Is this a mapping failure?

ops: We had a webhook replay window at 04:12 UTC for invoice.updated events. Consumer logs show `event_id=null` for replays between 04:12-04:18.

kate: If event_id is null our idempotency key falls back to invoice_number only and reconciler may skip fee patch that runs on first-seen event.

oliver: Pulled logs: `replayer normalized event, removed meta.promo_tag` which reconciler needs to add experimental_fee.

nora: Blast radius estimate: 90 invoices, ~$7.2k total. Mostly experiment cohort C.

billing-bot: ACTION_CREATED by oliver: #investigation FIN-5459 assigned to kate, due 2026-03-28

ops: Mitigation: disabled automatic DLQ replays and paused the webhook proxy sanitize rule. Manual replay only.

kate: Quick patch: reconciler will attempt a secondary lookup by matching stripe.line_descriptions for known experiment suffixes when meta missing. Low-risk. Deploying to staging now.

finance-ops: We need a dry-run and an audit trail before any NetSuite writes. Also a rollback plan.

oliver: Plan: 1) Run reconciler dry-run to generate patch CSV with invoice_id, expected_fee_amount, ns_internal_id 2) Sandbox apply and review ledger effects 3) Production backfill in small batches with pre/post checksums.

nora: Also fix replayer to preserve event_id and promo metadata. Add e2e test asserting idempotency across replay.

ops: I'll add a guard so replayer attaches `replay_origin=dlq` and preserves original event_id header.

billing-bot: NOTE: auto-replay disabled by ops at 2026-03-28T04:20:00Z

finance-ops: Approved for sandbox dry-run and conditional production backfill after we review the CSV and rollback steps. Keep finance cc'd.

oliver: ETA for dry-run CSV: 2 hours. Customer comms: if customers ask, say we are reconciling and refunds/credits will be reflected in next statement within 72 hours.

kate: Posting dry-run artifacts to the shared drive when ready.

ops: Monitoring alerts set for webhook_consumer_null_event_id and dlq_replay_count.
